sourceAuthority: T4032-AB Payroll Deductions Tables — Alberta 2026 + T4127 Alberta Table 8.1
verificationNote: Alberta Table 8.1 (annualised) 2026 V (rate) and KP (bracket constant) values as installed in H1/H2 packages. Also asserts Alberta BPA and the K5P block (§H).

expected.notes: Alberta BPA + first-bracket rate used across the K1P/K2P/K2AP/K3P credit chain.

expected.sourceCitation: T4127 §Alberta (K5P) — 2%-over-8% supplemental credit applied to annualised Alberta tax base above $4,800.
expected.notes: K5P must be explicitly present-or-absent on the pinned package — never a missing-field default. `enabled: true` means the calculator will apply K5P; `enabled: false` documents deliberate non-application.
